bio_en: Harutiun of Moks, known as Akhper ('Brother'), came from a modest village household and was the most agile and pugnacious of his peers, often fighting hostile Kurds and landing in the local jail. In 1890 he left the Izmir and Constantinople area for his native Moks, and in 1894-95 was mostly in town; once a revolutionary, he turned his strength solely against the common enemy, leading bands and living and fighting with Peto. In 1897 he joined the ARF bands gathering at Aravul. Long confinement and hardship broke his health, and he died after a long illness at the monastery of St Thaddeus (Gaghtashen) on 25 June 1902, aged about forty.
